strictGate.reason: The current environment does not contain the npm runtime dependencies required to generate the complete DOCX bank. Registry/DNS access is unavailable, so the strict DOCX -> LibreOffice render -> SSIM gate cannot be rerun here. v11 remains the last strict-SSIM stable release.

changes: Large internal OCR gaps are represented as geometric Word tab stops instead of being collapsed into ordinary spaces.
Continuous prose remains continuous text; segmentation uses relative OCR geometry and page typography rather than document/page-specific rules.
OCR font fitting uses the summed ink-bearing widths of geometric segments, excluding inter-column blank space from the font-size estimate.
High-confidence OCR segments may receive a conservative horizontal Word run scale when the required correction is within plus/minus 10 percent.
The headless benchmark now carries native and OCR run geometry and derives the same line segments used by runtime conversion.
The segmentation threshold was tuned against all 40 OCR pages in the validation bank and finalized at a conservative 3.7 times line font size with zero proxy regressions.

segmentGeometryProxy.description: OCR word-start horizontal geometry proxy comparing v13 continuous-line layout with v14 segmented layout. This is not SSIM and is not a substitute for the strict render gate.

rejectedExperiments.name: robust-vertical-baseline-recalibration
rejectedExperiments.reason: It affected too many OCR lines without strict render evidence. v14 retains v13 vertical/baseline behavior rather than accepting a broad unproven change.
